title: Blink-182 bandmate had intelligence community ties

tellings.quote: >> what? So then another member of Blink 182 had family members in the in the intelligence community,

plain: Another member of the rock band Blink-182, besides the guitarist Tom DeLonge, who went on to work on UFO projects, had relatives in the US intelligence agencies. The researcher Jay Anderson brings this up on the show as something he was told, hinting that the band's link to the UFO world may run deeper than DeLonge alone.
